claims.claim: Matching subset-DP in MatchingGraph.feasible_masks agrees with an independent matching recurrence on all labeled simple graphs with n=5.
claims.limits: Finite n=5 only; does not establish asymptotic complexity or universal implementation equivalence.

claims.claim: DeltaMatroid constructor acceptance agrees with an independent symmetric-exchange predicate over every nonempty set family on n=3.
On all n=3 delta-matroids tested, the implemented Theorem-A-related predicates agree: weak Wenzel, hyperplane exchange, parity-completed lift even-delta status, and the antipode condition.
claims.scope: All nonempty delta-matroid families on n=3
claims.limits: Empirical finite-domain confirmation of theorem characterisations, not an independent proof of the theorem.

claims.claim: On all n=3 even delta-matroids tested, Wenzel and hyperplane-even exchange agree.
The lazy BitmaskExchangeEngine neighbor relation agrees with the independent dmlib exchange-neighbor oracle on the tested n=7 matching family.
claims.scope: One independently specified n=7 matching graph family
claims.limits: Targeted family, not exhaustive over all n=7 families.

claims.claim: The repository modular determinant agrees with the independent dmlib determinant on fixed integer matrices over F_101.
The historical unordered-pair weak verifier is not a sound replacement for full symmetric exchange.
claims.limits: Protects a known counterexample; does not characterize all unsound verifier variants.

claims.claim: Repository-level research claims should retain branch/commit provenance and distinguish evaluator result from scientific conclusion.
claims.limits: Methodological control; not a mathematical result.

claims.claim: binary_representable agrees with exhaustive enumeration of symmetric GF(2) matrices and all their twists for every parity-uniform family on n=4.
claims.scope: All parity-uniform families on n=4; all 2^(4*5/2) symmetric GF(2) matrices and all twists
claims.limits: Finite n=4 and the implemented principal-minor/twist model only.

claims.claim: ternary_representable agrees with exhaustive enumeration of skew-symmetric GF(3) matrices and all their twists for every parity-uniform family on n=4.
claims.scope: All parity-uniform families on n=4; all 3^6 skew upper-triangular GF(3) assignments and all twists
claims.limits: Finite n=4 and the implemented GF(3) sign-normalized model; larger n and cap-limited cases remain outside this exhaustive evidence.

claims.claim: ternary_representable preserves later decidable twists after a cap-limited candidate is skipped, returning UNKNOWN only when no later candidate establishes representability.
claims.limits: Protects the discovered early-return failure mode; does not prove all cap-edge cases.
